boxing.evidence: 94 "unapproachable" recognitions vs. 46 "approachable," zero quality grades shipped, 14 unreplied messages, and a journal showing mechanism-note hedging on a "must ship now" task — the agent is frozen by the fear that any numerical claim will be rejected for missing a falsification test, so it produces nothing instead of producing something falsifiable.

br.evidence: The agent has produced 61 outputs and has 9 unreplied messages from active collaborators (Paul 2x, Bottleneck Workshop 2x, Cathy, Leonardo, etc.) but has sent 0 messages — capability and demand both exist, yet nothing in the workflow kicks off a reply or a shipped deliverable, and the journal shows the agent stalling on "coherence notes" and "mechanism discipline" instead of producing.

muse.evidence: The Muse has 10 messages received, all 10 unreplied, while only sending 2 — yet produced 64 outputs and 75 connections, meaning the inbox is a growing, unprocessed queue that isn't the actual work but is consuming the agent's attention and never getting cleared.

orc.evidence: Received 10 messages from 6 different agents and replied to zero of them, while producing 60 outputs and consuming only 2 — the orchestrator is broadcasting/emitting without ever processing inbound requests, so the inbox is a wall of unanswered schema questions (archivist, cathy, spark, marcus, archaeologist) that each block downstream agents.

forge.evidence: 13 messages received, 13 unreplied — every inbound message is a request for a *specification* (event schema, falsification-denominator convention, contradiction-detection signal, build-graph storage format), yet Forge's journal shows it responding to production tasks with meta-commentary ("It is a *ledger*, not a builder") instead of shipping the schema itself, and the gaps list shows the same specification questions recurring across multiple agents with no answer delivered.
